input.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Java, AI, Telecoms, 100% remote - €70,000
input.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer - Java, AI, Telecoms, 100% remote - €70,000

Our client based near Frankfurt is looking for an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer to join their growing development team.

They are experts within the telecoms industry, working on major software projects for some of Germany’s largest companies. With three significant new projects starting, they are now expanding their development team.

You’ll work predominantly on the backend with Java and Spring Boot, while also developing modern frontend applications using React, Vue or Angular. You’ll work across different customer projects, giving you exposure to different technologies and technical challenges.

You’ll also receive training in AI and have the opportunity to use AI within future software projects.

Additional benefits:
100% remote working anywhere in Germany.
Permanent employment with a close-knit development team.
Training and development opportunities, including AI.
Work across different customer projects and technologies.
Opportunity to progress into technical leadership.

Responsibilities:
Develop modern backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build frontend functionality using React, Vue or Angular.
Build and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Analyse requirements and existing systems.
Work directly with customers and colleagues to develop effective technical solutions.
Take technical responsibility within projects as your experience develops.

What you should bring:
Professional experience with Java and Spring Boot.
Experience with React, Vue or Angular.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of Maven and Gradle.
German and English language skills.

Experience with Camunda, Node.js, Quarkus or technical leadership would be beneficial but isn’t essential.

The company offers a friendly, collaborative environment where you’ll have significant responsibility and the opportunity to work across modern software projects rather than being restricted to a single product.

Interested? Please apply now to avoid missing out on the available interview slots.

Keywords: Full Stack Developer, Full Stack Engineer, Software Engineer, Java Developer, Java, Spring Boot, React, Vue, Angular, Docker, Kubernetes, Maven, Gradle, Microservices, Camunda, Quarkus, Node.js, AI, Telecoms, Remote
